mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities; leflunomide's active metabolite is renally cleared and foscarnet requires careful renal monitoring, creating compounded renal injury risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely (creatinine, BUN) and serum electrolytes (particularly calcium, phosphate, magnesium) at baseline and frequently during concurrent use; adjust dosing based on renal function and consider alternative antivirals if possible.
